title: Wisdom is one unity from the Essence to the last world

lectures.id: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3
Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

overview: Chapter 8 carries the chapter 7 *yichud* into wisdom and then into the rest of the chain. G-d's wisdom is one from the top of the chain to the bottom; a person who contemplates it in each world sees it all as one unit. Wisdom comes from the simple unity of the Essence, from an *ayin* that is not a true nothing, unlike the will, and it descends from world to world by cause and effect, each *Malchus* becoming the *Keser* of the next. Each step is G-d's own wisdom, so the physical world is made with great wisdom, as Solomon's wisdom and the Holy of Holies show. A person's wisdom works the same way: whether he learns an abstract idea or a physical skill, it is one essential power, and it spreads from thought to *middos* to action. The same *yichud* applies to the *middos* and to thought, speech and action in each of the four worlds, and to the physical world down to its smallest detail. The chapter closes with the general *yichud*: from the *Ein Sof* down to *Malchus* of *Asiya* is one essence, and G-d is the place of the world, not the world His place.

sections.title: Wisdom is one unity, and it descends from the Essence by cause and effect
sections.summary: The unity that joins the crown's details to the simple will applies to wisdom. Wisdom comes from the simple unity of the Essence and descends world by world, each *Malchus* becoming the *Keser* of the next; the one wisdom creates, forms and makes.

phrases.en: So, just like we explained in the previous chapter with that concept of *Keser* of G-d's will, how there is this idea of uniting all of the many details and seeing how they all go back to the original source or the general big picture, in other words, all the way that everything unites to G-d's simple will in His essence.

blocks.text: The class picks up chapter 7's theme: a *yichud* that joins every level from beginning to end, until the many stages become one unit, transparent. He gives the picture of learning to read. First come the letters, their sounds, the words, their definitions and grammar, then the meaning and the inner intent. In the end you read and see the meaning at once, and you forget that you are reading. So too G-d's will passes through all the stages and is really only what He wants. The same *yichud* is now to be seen in His *chachma* and in the *middos*.

blocks.text: The *Keser* has a *yichud*: all its details join the whole, up to G-d's simple will in the Essence, which is *Ein Sof* itself. So too a person can contemplate the *chachma* in every world, from the top to the bottom, and see how it all unites into G-d's essential *chachma*.

blocks.text: *Chachma* comes *me'ayin*, from nothing, but not from a true nothing. *Keser* is the true *ayin*; *chachma* is already a *yesh*, something. The *seder hishtalshelus* has two places where a *yesh* is made from nothing: from *Keser* to *Chachma* at the start, and in the creation of physical matter at the end. Everything between is *ila v'alul*, cause and effect, though those two are the true acts of creation. The *ratzon* is truly *ayin*, unlike *chachma*, which only comes from it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Just as the will contracts from the Essence until it is clothed in action, doing whatever it desires, so too *chachma* contracts from the Essence.

blocks.text: Chachma is called the original *chachma*, or the simple *chachma* within the simple unity. From that source G-d can make any wisdom He wants for Himself. The *Ba'al Shem Tov* explains, as the *Tanya* mentions, that in *chachma* everything is transparent to G-d: *ein od milvado*. Something can exist as a *yesh*, yet its existence is entirely a self-expression of G-d.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: From the simple wisdom it descends from the top down through every world of *ABYA*, until it reaches the lowest wisdom, in the *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, the wisdom expressed in our physical world. We look around and see tremendous wisdom. That is why it says *kulam bechochma asisa*, You made everything with wisdom: everything in the physical world is made with great wisdom.

blocks.text: Just as we said of the will, *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are created, formed and made by one will. It is all one *ratzon*, the same power by which G-d wants something. To do it there is a whole process, but it expresses the same essential *ratzon*.

phrases.en: just that it goes through the whole process from *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya*, and that's the way that G-d set it up, that there's this whole hierarchy and it goes from cause to effect

blocks.text: The chain descends from *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya* in the levels of cause and effect. That is how G-d set it up: a whole hierarchy in which each comes from the one above it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The *Malchus* of the *Keser* of *Beriya* becomes the *Keser* of *Yetzira*, and so from level to level.

blocks.text: The aim in learning the levels in detail is to see them connect into one fluid unit, not a heap of separate concepts. As with *Keser*, it is one desire expressed in different ways, so it is one *chachma*, and with that same *chachma* G-d created, formed and made everything.

sections.title: Wisdom in the chain, and the Holy of Holies
sections.summary: The wisdom of the Essence passes through *Adam Kadmon*, *Atzilus* and *Beriya* to Solomon's wisdom in *Asiya*, and it shines in the *Beis HaMikdash*.

blocks.text: The same goes from *Yetzira* to *Asiya*, to the *chachma* in the *Malchus* of *Asiya*. That is why it says *kulam bechochma asisa*, that You made everything with wisdom. The verse *Havaya bechochma yasad aretz* says the same: the physical world comes from G-d's wisdom, just as *Atzilus* and *Beriya* do.

blocks.text: Walking outside, we should see that even the simplest things around us are literally the wisdom of G-d's essence. It does not have to be only in the higher levels and the angels.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: Seeing wisdom in people and in the body
blocks.text: G-d decided in His wisdom to make the world with people who are flawed, not yet the great *tzaddikim*, who have things to work on. We should each need the others and work together, as the body is made: each organ has its advantages and its lacks, and they are complete only together; sometimes one is sick while another is healthy. Seeing that harmony should bring us to unity and love for each other. The *Ba'al Shem Tov* had this tremendous love for every person and every creature G-d made.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Even in detail, *chachma* does not pass directly from *Beriya* to *Yetzira*. It goes from the *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Beriya*, which becomes the *Keser* of *Yetzira*, and the *chachma* of *Yetzira* comes from the *Malchus* of *Keser* of *Yetzira*. In general, once the process is understood, the stages in between are transparent and do not matter.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: Passing a message along
blocks.text: A teacher gives a message to a student by phone, and it goes by satellites across the world, but we say he told the student. Once you know that each stage faithfully carries what is in between, you skip them. Nobody traces the sound waves to the eardrum; it is self-understood. So we say *chachma* goes from *Atzilus* to *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya*.

blocks.text: This is G-d's essential *chachma*, from the *chachma* of the *Essence* of *Ein Sof*. It goes to the *chachma* of *Adam Kadmon*, then to the *chachma* of *Atik* and *Arich*, of *Keser* of *Atzilus*; then to the level of *Abba*, the *partzuf* of *chachma* of *Atzilus*, to the *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus*, and then to the *chachma* of *Malchus* of *Beriya*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: וכן על דרך זה מבריאה ליצירה ומיצירה לעשיה,
phrases.en: and it went from *Atzilus* to *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: עד שבא האור ושפע חכמה אלהי״ת הזאת בנשמת שלמה מחכמה שבמלכות דעשיה

blocks.text: The same way, from *Beriya* to *Yetzira* to *Asiya*, until the light and flow of G-dly *chachma* came into Solomon's soul from the *chachma* in *Malchus* of *Asiya*. When G-d gives a blessing like this, it goes through the whole *seder hishtalshelus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So it is not a constant miracle that Solomon became so wise. G-d set it all up in *Asiya* to give him the *chachma*: his brain was a smart brain, he probably had good teachers, and all the physical things he needed. But all that comes from G-d's essential *chachma*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: וכן בהיכל קדש הקדשים שבבית המקדש האיר מכתר וחכמה שבעצמיות
phrases.en: we say that G-d's essential *Keser* and *chachma*, essential wisdom and will of His essence were shining, were being expressed in the Holy of Holies in the *Beis HaMikdash*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: עד בחינת כתר וחכמה שבהיכל קדש קדשים דעשיה
phrases.en: all the way down, not just the spiritual Holy of Holies in *Beriya* and *Yetzira*, but all the way to the physical one in our physical world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: בלוחות וארון גשמיים שהיו עומדים בהיכל קדש קדשים הבנוי למטה,
phrases.en: in the physical tablets, and the physical Ark, that in the physical building that was built down here

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: היה שורה מכתר וחכמה דהיכל קדש קדשים דעשיה הרוחניות כו'
phrases.en: and from there the spiritual world of *Yetzira*, and the spiritual world of *Beriya*, and all the way up to G-d's essential *Keser* and *chachma* of the *Atzmus*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The same is true in the *Beis HaMikdash*. In its Holy of Holies, G-d's essential *Keser* and *chachma* were being expressed, all the way down to the Holy of Holies of *Asiya* in the physical building.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Down to the physical tablets and the physical Ark in the building built here below. In that building the *Keser* and *chachma* of the spiritual Holy of Holies of *Asiya* were resting, and from there the spiritual worlds of *Yetzira* and *Beriya*, all the way up to G-d's essential *Keser* and *chachma* of the *Atzmus*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

sections.title: A person's wisdom: one power, from abstract thought to a physical act
sections.summary: A person's essential wisdom is the same whether he learns an abstract idea or a physical skill. It spreads from thought to *middos* to action.

phrases.he: (וכך אנו מבקשים, אתה חונן לאדם דעת כו'
phrases.en: and we actually, each of us, every single day in *Shmoneh Esrei*, we pray that G-d should grant us *daas*, knowledge and understanding

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: וחננו מאתך
phrases.en: and we say, it should come from You, from G-d himself

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: דוקא כו'
ודי למבין)

blocks.text: Every day in *Shmoneh Esrei* we pray that G-d grant us *daas*, knowledge and understanding, and we say it should come from Him. Even when the blessing of wisdom comes through this whole process, it really comes from G-d Himself.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: (ועל דרך משל הנה יובן באדם התחתון, כמו שחכמתו העצמיות ההיולית כולל כל הסתעפות התפשטות אור חכמתו, עד לחוץ מעצמות שלו לגמרי

blocks.text: The goal is to learn to see things this way. Even with all the stages in between, and physical things happening, even the *Krias Yam Suf*, an open miracle, is something physical happening in *Asiya*: a wind was blowing and so on. G-d arranged what needed to happen in the physical world to make it happen, and the same with all such things.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: We should learn on two sides. G-d's essence comes down through the process, clothed in the lower levels until it comes out in something physical. And we should not let that clothing, which one could regard as just *teva*, nature, hide that it is controlled and commanded by G-d, so it comes from G-d Himself.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: The candies at the cheder
blocks.text: A child's first haircut and his first day in *cheder* are marked with candies, and the family tells him that the angel Michael, the angel of kindness, threw them. It is not a lie: whenever a person does something kind for another, that is an expression of that angel. So a spiritual *malach* is expressed in a physical form.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Whenever the Gemara or the *Midrashim* tell of *Eliyahu HaNavi* or some *malach* doing a miracle for someone, it always came in some physical garment. If Eliyahu's spirit came into an officer who decided to do the right thing and stand against everybody, that man was the garment of the *malach*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: A person's essential chachma
blocks.text: This is understood in a person. G-d gives us an essential power of *chachma*, the ability to learn, recognize truth, be creative and come up with ideas. It is a *hiyuli* power, unlimited and undefined, an abstract thing. It is the source of every expression of *chachma* in a person, and it reaches to things completely outside the person.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: והוא עד שכל המלובש בעשיה גשמית, נבדלת לגמרי

blocks.text: A person can learn something very simple and physical: how to work something, how to drive, how to get directions, a new app on the phone. Each requires a certain amount of *chachma*. It comes down into a very simple physical thing, but it still comes from your essential *chachma*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ואין הפרש אצלו בין התפשטות חכמתו העצמיות בעצם שכלו להשכיל עיון שכלי,
phrases.en: and really to the person's essential power of *chachma*, there's no difference whether the person is learning some new abstract concept, some deep idea

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: להתפשטות שלה בעשיה נבדלת
phrases.en: or whether they're learning some physical thing

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: שהכל נקרא בשם התחכמות אחד,
phrases.en: it's all equally called *hischakmus*, it's called, you know, learning or creating or ingenuity

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: אלא שזה ברוחניות ובעצמותו יותר, ובעשיה בא בדבר נבדל
phrases.en: just that in the one case a person is thinking about more lofty, spiritual things, and when they're doing something physical, it's something more external from the person

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: To a person's essential power of *chachma* there is no difference between learning a new abstract concept or a deep idea and learning a physical thing. Either way you do not know it, and you must apply creativity and ingenuity to conceive it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: It is all called *hischakmus*: learning, creating or ingenuity. In the abstract it is more lofty and essential; in the physical it is a matter outside the person, more external.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: עד שלגבי בחינת העצמות ממש
phrases.en: but to the person's essence, the real essence of the person, it's all the same, and they can just apply it here and apply it there

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: הרי הכל רק התחכמות אחד, רק שהולכת ומתפשטת מעיון שכלו למדותיו
phrases.en: it's just that this essential *chachma* goes through this process and it becomes extended from the abstract thought to the person's emotions

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ולמחשבתו,
phrases.en: to the person's thoughts

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: עד שעושה ממש בחכמתו זו
phrases.en: until a person is able to actually take some action that's guided by their *chachma*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: כמו בהתחכמות בעסק משא ומתן כו')
phrases.en: like a person that's using their wisdom to conduct some sort of business

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: To the person's essence it is all one *hischakmus*, applied here or there. It is just that this essential *chachma* spreads from the abstract thought to the person's *middos* and to his *machshava*, until he acts, guided by his *chachma*, as in making a craft.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.title: Doing business
blocks.text: Like a person using his wisdom to conduct business. It takes intelligence and learning even though it is a simple physical thing; you have to learn it.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

sections.title: Speech, light and the source: one wisdom from the Essence, and "I am first and last"
sections.summary: Light, speech and every detail come from G-d's essential wisdom, and in the Essence the first and the last are the same.

phrases.he: וכמו ויאמר אלהי״ם יהי אור
phrases.en: like it says, and G-d said, "Let there be light"

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: שבדיבור,
phrases.en: so that was something that was expressed in words, so to speak

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ובא לידי מעשה
phrases.en: and it came out as an action

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב ויהי אור
phrases.en: and there was light

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: Like it says, G-d said, "Let there be light." The source of light is only wisdom, but that wisdom came down to be an expression of G-d's saying, until it became physical light, a physical expression of *chachma*. So G-d's wisdom comes from stage to stage down to the lowest physical level.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: הרי התחלתו מבחינת חכמתו העצמית שבעצמיות המאציל
שהאציל האור
phrases.en: that the original source of the physical light that we have is from G-d's wisdom, and He invented and emanated this idea of light

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ואחר כך ברא ויצר ועשה כו'
phrases.en: so G-d's essential *chachma* came and went to *Beriya* and *Yetzira* and *Asiya* until it became our physical light

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The start is G-d's essential *chachma* in the Essence of the emanator. He emanated the light, and it started as a G-dly thing and came all the way down; G-d created a physical form for the light and made the sun and the rest to shine. So G-d's essential *chachma* went to *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* until it became our physical light.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: וכך הוא בכל פרטי התהוות הנאצלים והנבראים והנוצרים והמעשים
phrases.en: and so too with every single detail of our world that first there has to be that essential G-dly force that G-d is deciding to create it

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: מעצמות האין סוף כו'
phrases.en: but it all comes from the *Atzmus* of *Ein Sof*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: כולם מיוחדים ומקושרים כל פרטיהם בעצמיות אור אין סוף שבאבי''ע
phrases.en: so all of the details of everything in all of the *seder hishtalshelus* are already united and connected with all their details back to the essence of the infinite light

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: So too with every detail of what is created, formed and made: first the G-dly force decides to create it and comes up with its idea, its nature and its purpose. Then G-d gives it a character and a form, and arranges the events in our reality that bring it about. All of it comes from the *Atzmus* of *Ein Sof*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: All the details of everything in the *seder hishtalshelus* are already united and connected, each with all its details, to the essence of the infinite light.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ואין הפרש לגבי עצמו בין ראשון לאחרון כלל
phrases.en: and to G-d's essence there's no difference to the *chachma* that's in *Atzilus* than the *chachma* that's in the lowest level in *Asiya*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

phrases.he: ואם כן מה שכתוב אני ראשון ואני אחרון קאי גם בבחינת החכמה שבראש האצילות עד חכמה שבסוף העשיה כו'
phrases.en: if so, that G-d is expressed both at the beginning, and the same way He's expressed all the way at the end of the seder hishtalshelus, that doesn't just apply to Keser, it also applies to chachma

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: To G-d's essence there is no difference between the *chachma* in *Atzilus* and the *chachma* in the lowest level of *Asiya*. So when it says *ani rishon ve'ani acharon*, I am first and I am last, that applies not only to *Keser* but also to *chachma*: G-d's essence is found equally at the beginning of *Atzilus* and at the end of *Asiya*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

blocks.text: The point of learning the details is to see that the *seder hishtalshelus*, however many stages, changes nothing essential. It is still G-d's essential *chachma*, and it passes through the stages without changing. Keep this in mind at each stage: how it does not change, how it is still connected to G-d and is still an expression of His essence, and then join the levels into one unit.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 054 ch 8 part 1.mp3

sections.title: The midos, thought, speech and action are one in the same way
sections.summary: The same general *yichud* applies to the *middos* and to *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh* in each of the four worlds, and to the *chesed* of the *Ein Sof*. The chain of *midos* is rooted in the Essence.

phrases.he: וכן יובן על דרך זה דרך פרט בחינת יחוד כללי בבחינת המדות ומחשבה דבור ומעשה
phrases.en: the similar thing applies to the *middos* and the *machshava*, *dibur*, and *maaseh*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שבכל עולם מד' עולמות דאבי''ע
phrases.en: of every world of the four worlds of *Atzilus*, *Beriya*, *Yetzira*, *Asiya*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שמדות דאצילות מתלבשים במדות דבריאה ומדות דבריאה במדות דיצירה ומדות דיצירה במדות דעשיה,
phrases.en: that it's the emotions of *Atzilus* are then expressed in *Beriya*, which is expressed in *Yetzira*, which is expressed in the emotions of *Asiya*, until the most external aspects of the emotions, which is the six directions

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: עד שבחינת ו׳ קצוות דעשיה נעוץ בתחלת הכל, במדותיו העצמיים שלפני האצילות
phrases.en: which is like a physical measurement of physical things, that's the idea of its six extremities of the physical world of *Asiya*, rooted in the beginning of everything, in G-d's essential *midos*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The class sums up the last one: G-d's will and then His wisdom are expressed all the way down to the physical world, and there is infinite wisdom in each physical detail. Now the same is shown for the other parts of the chain, the *middos* and the rest.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.outOfPlace: The class opens by summing up the last one, so the chapter's own lines begin after it.

blocks.text: The same kind of general *yichud* applies to the *middos* and to *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh*, in each of the four worlds of *ABYA*: seeing how all the details connect up to the essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The *midos* of *Atzilus* are clothed in the *midos* of *Beriya*, those of *Beriya* in those of *Yetzira*, and those of *Yetzira* in *Asiya*, until the six extremities of *Asiya*, the physical dimensions, are rooted in the beginning of all, in G-d's essential *midos* before *Atzilus*. They express the essential *midos* by which He chose to measure Himself out.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שעל זה אמר המתנשא מימות עולם כידוע
phrases.en: about this, about G-d's essential *midos*, it says that G-d transcends the days of the world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: והם בחינת ז׳ תחתונים דעתיק יומין
phrases.en: and this idea of these *midos* that transcend the worlds are the seven lower *sefiros* of *Atik*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: עד ז׳ תחתונים דאדם קדמון עד מדות שבאור אין סוף עצמו הגנוזות בעצמות שלו ממש
phrases.en: and even higher than that, the seven lower *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*, all the way to the *midos* that are hidden in the essence of the *Ein Sof*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: *Yomos*, days, here stands for the six *midos* the world was created with, or the seven days of creation. About G-d's essential *midos* it says that He transcends the days of the world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: These *midos* that transcend the worlds are the seven lower *sefiros* of *Atik* and of *Adam Kadmon*, and higher still, the *midos* hidden in the essence of the *Ein Sof* itself, before the *tzimtzum*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו בחינת חסד שבאור אין סוף עצמו, שעל זה אמר חסדי יהו״ה כי לא תמנו כו' בבחינת אין סוף ממש
phrases.en: like the essential *chesed* of the *Ein Sof*, about which it says *chasdei Hashem ki lo tamnu*, that we say it's G-d's essential kindness that does not end, and it's truly infinite

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אנו אומרים יהי חסדך זה עלינו
phrases.en: we also say, that G-d's kindness, in other words this very kindness, this essential unlimited kindness of G-d that's infinite, which means that it transcends all the limits of the world, that very kindness we ask that it be brought down upon us

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ממש
phrases.en: we ask G-d to bestow that kindness on us, literally

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בבחינת חסד מצומצם שבמדות דמלכות דמלכות דעשיה שמאיר בעולם הזה כו'
phrases.en: but we are asking that it should come down into the very limited *midos* of the lowest physical expression of our physical world, which is actually shining into our physical world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Like the essential *chesed* of the *Ein Sof*, about which it says *chasdei Hashem ki lo tamnu*: G-d's essential kindness that does not end, truly infinite.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: We also say *yehi chasdecha Hashem alenu*, let Your kindness be upon us: this very essential, unlimited kindness, which transcends the limits of the world, is what we ask to be brought down on us, literally. It comes down into the very limited *midos* of our physical world, which shines into this world, so we ask for life, health, livelihood and all we need, as an expression of G-d's essential kindness.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכן מבחינת מחשבה שבעצמותו נמשך עד בחינת מחשבה דמלכות דעשיה,
phrases.en: in a similar way, that very thought is what's coming all the way down to *Malchus* of *Asiya*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אשר חושב לעשות בפועל ממש
phrases.en: of so to speak thinking, planning out what He's going to do, the intention behind every action that's guiding everything that happening in our physical world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכן בדבור ומעשה כו',
phrases.en: and the same thing with G-d the divine speech that's creating everything, that the final word of G-d that's creating our physical world is coming from G-d's essential self-expression, and the same thing with *maaseh*, the idea of action

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כי כמו שכל אשר חפץ ברצון העצמות עושה, כך כל אשר חפץ ברצונו העצמי חושב
phrases.en: that just like everything that it says, everything that G-d desires He does, so G-d's *ratzon* comes all the way down to the physical world, so too everything that He desires goes into His thought

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כו'
phrases.en: and it's all expression of His choice in His essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: רק שיורד ונמשך בהשתלשלות עד חפצו ורצונו ושכלו ומחשבתו בעשיה בפועל ממש כו'
phrases.en: it descends all the way until it's expressed in G-d's desire and will and intellect and thought in the physical, final physical action of our world

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אבל הכל רק רצון ושכל ומדה ומחשבה ומעשה אחד תחשב לגבי בחינת העצמות ממש, כמובן מכל הנ"ל וד"ל.
phrases.en: nevertheless, it's really all one thing

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: G-d's essential thought comes all the way down to the *Malchus* of *Asiya*: to what He plans to make happen in fact, like thinking through and planning what He will do, the intention behind every action that guides what happens in our physical world.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The same with speech and action: just as G-d's will made everything that is desired, so everything He desires He thinks of. The divine speech that creates our physical world, and action too, come from G-d's essential self-expression.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The essential will, *chachma*, *middos*, thought, speech and action all descend from G-d's desire and will until they are expressed in the physical action of our world, which is what G-d wanted. There are contractions and stages, but it is one desire.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: What we see in front of us is G-d's *chachma*, *middos*, thought, speech and action. This is enough to understand the basic idea of a general *yichud*: it is all one.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: After learning all the details, we want to see how everything comes from G-d's essence and descends through the whole *seder hishtalshelus*, all connected, and not to see each detail as a separate thing. The main point is not to understand each stage separately, but to see that the stage does not change and is still an expression of the essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

sections.title: The physical world: every detail from its source
sections.summary: Looking at the physical world, not even its smallest detail is separate from its highest source, and that brings wonder, awe and love.

phrases.he: ואחכ"ז הרי ישכיל האדם בהתבוננותו במי ברא אלה בגשמיות,
phrases.en: and then we turn our attention, once we see how everything's connected, we turn our attention to the physical world, and contemplate, who created all of these

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: איך שלא נבדל גם הפרט היותר אחרון מהמקור הכללי היותר ראשון
phrases.en: we look around us and see the wonders and the beauty and the awesomeness of G-d's creations in our physical world, and see the *hashgacha pratis*, and see that not even the smallest, most minute detail of our lowest physical world is in any way separate from its highest original source

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: גם בכל פרט שבכל דבר ודבר כמו בבריאת שמים או ארץ או כל פרטי חלקי דומם צומח חי ומדבר
phrases.en: even the smallest details of everything, like the creations of the heavens or the earth, and all the little minutiae, the details of *domem*, *tzomeach*, *chai*, *medaber*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: איך ששרשם ברוחניות דמלכות דעשיה עד רום המעלות אחוז וקשור כשלשלת כו'
phrases.en: how all of these physical things are coming from their spiritual source in *Malchus* of *Asiya*, and from there they're connected all the way up to the highest levels like a chain

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Having seen that everything is connected, we contemplate who created all these. We look at the wonders and beauty of G-d's creations in the physical world and see *hashgacha pratis*, and see that not even the smallest and most minute detail of the lowest physical world is separate from its highest source.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Even the smallest details of everything, such as the creation of the heavens and the earth and all the details of *domem*, *tzomeach*, *chai* and *medaber*: the rocks and the elements and their chemistry, plants and how they draw energy from light, living creatures from microbes to the largest animals and human life. Looking at all these details, we should be filled with wonder.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That it exists at all, with such wisdom and precision and awesomeness, has no end to what we can see and appreciate. When we recognize it as the handiwork and the desire and the wisdom of G-d, we should feel awe, wonder, beauty, love, fear and reverence for what we see around us.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The Ba'al Shem Tov in the woods
blocks.text: The *Ba'al Shem Tov* loved to go out into the woods, to be with nature and look at the beauty of G-d's work.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: All these physical things come from their spiritual source in *Malchus* of *Asiya*, and from there they are connected all the way up to the highest levels, like a chain, and they all go back to G-d Himself.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכמו שכתוב בראשית ברא, בקדמין ובחוכמתא כו'
phrases.en: like we said before, that it says with *bereishis bara*, the simple meaning is that in the beginning G-d created, but it's translated here in a more kabbalistic way, that with G-d's *Keser* He created or with His wisdom He created

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: הרי בחינת כתר וחכמה שבאבי''ע מיוחדים
כך כל פרטיהם המסתעפים מהם במדות ובמחשבה דבור ומעשה שבכל עולם
phrases.en: so too all the details that are coming out from that wisdom and that will, all the details of the *midos* and the *machshava*, *dibur*, *maaseh* of every single world, everything that's created from them, is all one and united with G-d

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: (שהוא כללות עשר ספירות דכל עולם שהוא עתיק יומין ואריך אנפין ואבא ואימא וזעיר אנפין ונוקבא
phrases.en: and this is the idea that all of the generality, the ten *sefiros* of every world, which are these *partzufim* of *Atik*, *Arich*, *Abba*, *Ima*, *Zeir Anpin*, *Nukva* of all the four worlds of ABYA are all united with G-d's essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: דאבי״ע( עד בחינת עשיה דמלכות דעשיה, נעוץ סופן בתחלת הכל
phrases.en: until even the lowest level of the action of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, we should see how that lowest thing, when we look there, we should right away see how that's expressing and is connected all the way to the highest thing

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: דכמו שבקדמון האציל כו' כך בקדמון זה עצמו ברא ויצר ועשה, כמו שכתוב כל אשר חפץ כו'
phrases.en: just like we said with *Kadmon*, with this G-d's original, the *Keser* he emanated, so with that very same *Kadmon* he created and he formed and he made whatever he desired

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Like we said before: *bereishis bara* means in the beginning G-d created, but read more kabbalistically, with G-d's *Keser* He created, or with His wisdom He created. The *Keser* and *chachma* of *ABYA* are united.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Just as G-d's will and wisdom are one with Him, and the way they are expressed down in *ABYA* is still one with Him, so too all the details that come out of them, the *middos* and the *machshava*, *dibur* and *maaseh* of every world, are one and united with G-d.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: This is the ten *sefiros* of every world, which are the *partzufim* of *Atik*, *Arich*, *Abba*, *Ima*, *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* of all four worlds. They are all united with G-d's essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Even the lowest level, the action of *Malchus* of *Asiya*: when we look there, we should see right away how it is expressed and connected to the highest thing. The lowest is connected to, and in a way has an advantage over, what comes before the whole *seder hishtalshelus*: *reishis* is the beginning, but *tchilah* is what precedes it, so it is even higher.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Just as the *Keser* that G-d emanated was from the *kadmon*, with that very *Kadmon* He created, formed and made whatever He desired.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

sections.title: G-d is the place of the world
sections.summary: The six extremities are nullified to G-d's essence, and G-d is the place of the world, not the world His place.

phrases.he: וכך במדות,
phrases.en: and so too with the emotions

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו הנה מקום אתי,
phrases.en: like it says, *Behold, the place is with Me*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בחי' ביטול הו׳ קצוות
phrases.en: this is seeing this *bittul*, this nullification of the six directions, which again is like the external aspect of the *midos*, the dimensions, whether it's the spiritual dimensions or the physical dimensions

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: לך יהו״ה הגדולה,
phrases.en: and this is the idea like it says that *To You, Havaya, is greatness*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בכל עולם לפי מה שהוא
phrases.en: we're seeing how all those attributes within each world are *lecha*, are actually really a reflection and expression of G-d's

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: עד בחינת מקום העצמי שנקרא מקומו,
phrases.en: the physical place and the spiritual place of those *midos* go all the way up to the central place, so to speak, of G-d, which is called His place

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכמאמר רבותינו זכרונם לברכה הוא מקומו של עולם ואין העולם מקומו
phrases.en: It says that He is the place of the world, the world is not His place

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Like *hinei makom iti*, "Behold, the place is with Me": the spiritual and physical dimensions of time and space are nullified to G-d's essence and are an expression of it. This is *bittul* of the six extremities, the outer aspect of the *midos*. The spiritual dimensions are the source of the physical length, width and depth.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: *Lecha Hashem hagedula*, To You, Havaya, is the greatness. Within each world, the attributes of greatness, might and splendor are *lecha*, really a reflection and expression of G-d. Looking at the beauty and wonder of the world, we see that it reflects back to G-d's essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The physical place and the spiritual place of those *midos* go all the way up to G-d's central place, which is called His *makom*. As the sages say, He is the place of the world, and the world is not His place: G-d does not exist within the time and space of the world; He creates time and space, and they exist within His reality.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכן מאמר הידוע דאיהו תפיס בכל עלמין ולית מאן דתפיס ביה,
phrases.en: or similarly, like it says in the *Zohar*, that G-d grasps all the worlds, but nothing grasps Him

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אפילו מחשבה ורצון הקדום כו'
phrases.en: even the highest *ratzon* and *machshava* of the *seder hishtalshelus*, which is called *machshava v'ratzon hakadum*, that not even that can grasp G-d's essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ומכל זה הרי יובן בחינת יחוד וחיבור הפרט אל הכלל דרך כללות הכל מעצמיות אור אין סוף באבי''ע

blocks.text: As it says in the *Zohar*, G-d grasps all the worlds, but nothing grasps Him. He expresses Himself in all the worlds, but nothing in the world can truly capture Him or limit Him. It is a one-way connection: because He chooses to express Himself, His essence is found there, but none of these things can reach His essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Even the highest *ratzon* and *machshava* of the *seder hishtalshelus*, called *machshava v'ratzon hakadum*, cannot grasp G-d's essence; they are not a true vessel to capture who He is. He invests Himself so that He can be expressed there, but all exists within His greater reality, which transcends everything.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The *yichud* and joining of the particular to the general, through all of creation, comes from the essential infinite light in all four worlds.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

sections.title: One Malchus from the top to the bottom, and "I have not changed"
sections.summary: The general *yichud* is one essence reaching from the *Ein Sof* down to *Malchus* of *Asiya*. The *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* and of *Asiya* is one, and G-d has not changed.

phrases.he: מלבד בחינת היחוד שבכל עולם דרך פרט, בעשר ספירות שבו כו'
phrases.en: now we can understand this idea of how there's this general *yichud* aside from the specific *yichud*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: אך אף על פי שיודע האדם כל ביאור ההשתלשלות דאבי''ע בפרט,
phrases.en: so even after a person knows all the details of the *seder hishtalshelus* with all their details, that's not good enough

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ימשוך נפשו ליחוד הפרט אל היחוד בכלל,
phrases.en: a person should always be drawn, his desire should be drawn towards taking all those details and those specific unities and seeing how they connect and unite to this general, big-picture unity

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: עד עצמיות אור אין סוף ממש
phrases.en: until he sees how it's all really an expression of the very essence of the infinite light

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: על דרך הנזכר לעיל וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: like we talked about here, and other similar things

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: מלבד היחוד וביטול כל עולם בפרט לגבי העצמות כו'
phrases.en: aside from how each world has its specific local unity and *bittul* nullification to G-d's essence

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: עד שיבוא לו כל ההתבוננות שמרחיב בפרט בענין זה, בקיצור מופלג
phrases.en: until after studying this topic with all the many details, then a person is able to again put it all together and it becomes very short, and he sees it as one unit, and not as a bunch of separate details

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: There is a general *yichud*, apart from the particular: seeing how all the levels from top to bottom unite and express G-d's essence. The particular *yichud* is seeing that things in the physical world come from the *sefiros* of *Asiya*, or from *Yetzira*, or the unity in *Atzilus*: a local connection, stopping at a point in the *seder hishtalshelus*. The general *yichud* is seeing that the essence transcends and pervades from top to bottom and unites everything; it is not a local truth.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Even after a person knows all the details of the *seder hishtalshelus* in *ABYA*, that is not enough; just learning the book is not it. A person's soul should be drawn to take all the details and specific unities and see how they connect and unite in the general big-picture unity, until he sees that it is all an expression of the very essence of the infinite light. The same goes for each world's specific *yichud* and its *bittul* to G-d's essence.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: A person should study all the details, and then put it all together again, very briefly, so that he sees it as one unit, not as a bunch of separate details.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו מלכותך מלכות כל עולמים
phrases.en: like, for example, when we say *malchusecha malchus kol olamim*, that G-d's kingship is the kingship of all the worlds

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: שזהו בחינת מלכות דאין סוף במלכות דמלכות דעשיה
phrases.en: that you see how G-d's the infinite *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof* that is expressed and found all the way in *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: על דרך הנזכר לעיל ברצון וחכמה ומדות כו'
phrases.en: like we said before, with G-d's will and His wisdom and His *middos*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב ראו כי אני אני הוא ממש
phrases.en: see that I, I am He

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: וכן אני יהו״ה לא שניתי
phrases.en: similarly, it says, I am G-d, I do not change, or have not changed

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בחינת אני הוא בחינת מלכות, שהוא בחינת אין דכתר, דנעוץ תחלתן בסופן
phrases.en: so this *ani* is *Malchus*, and that represents, and is the same *ayin* of *Keser*; *ani* has the same letters as *ayin*. *Ayin* means abstract and transcendent, and *ani* means something that is very present and is revealed

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: Like *malchusecha malchus kol olamim*, Your kingship is the kingship of all the worlds: that is what we take to appreciate. There is a lot to learn about how that is so in each world; once you understand it, you can say, yes, this is true everywhere in all the worlds, a simple unifying truth.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The infinite *Malchus* is found all the way in *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*, as with the will, the wisdom and the *middos* discussed above.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: *Ani*, I, is *Malchus*. The external *Malchus* we see, *Malchus* of *Asiya*, is really the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*, the hidden *Malchus*, which is *ani hu*: "See that I, I am He."

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The Rebbe's well-known and somewhat controversial teaching about the Frierdiker Rebbe, that he is the Essence and Mahus clothed in a body, is what the class calls the practical side of this.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

sensitivity.reason: A contested Chassidic claim about a named Rebbe, the Frierdiker Rebbe, given as the Rebbe's own teaching (that he is atzmus and mahus clothed in a body): a movement's belief about its Rebbe, as the Rebbe-is-Moshiach belief is flagged in walters-original, and a public reader may take it as a claim about a person.
sensitivity.judgmentNote: Whether a public guide prints a contested claim about a named Rebbe. It is a reported teaching; only a reviewer can weigh whether it belongs in a public edition.

blocks.text: The Rebbe said that when you dance *hakafos*, holding onto another Jew, you should know you are holding *atzmus* and *mahus* clothed in a body. That is the unity this is about.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The ultimate appreciation of this unity comes after *Rosh Hashana*, *Yom Kippur* and *Sukkos*, and finally *Simchas Torah*. When we look at the world and at another person, we should recognize that this is what G-d chose to create. If I do not see the wisdom in it, that is my problem; I have to look deeper.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The king's choice
blocks.text: He believes this mashal is from *Kedushas Eynayim*: if a king chooses something and someone speaks against it, that is rebellion against the king. So G-d chose every Jew and everything in the world, and to think something bad about it is to rebel against the King. This is what He chose to make.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: So we look at it with that appreciation, with *bittul* and humility, which lets us have a deeper sense of unity.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: *Ani Havaya lo shinisi*, I am Havaya, I have not changed. So this *ani* is *Malchus*, which represents the *ayin* of *Keser*.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: *Ani* has the same letters as *ayin*, he says, and they mean opposite things: *ayin* is abstract and transcendent, *ani* is present and revealed. The way G-d is revealed in the world we see is the same essence as the transcendent G-d beyond all creation. *D'na'utz tchilasan b'sofan*: the beginning is fixed in the end.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: בכל עולם בפרט וכן דרך כללות הכל
phrases.en: that the highest level of G-d's essence is found and expressed within the end in the lowest final thing of every single world in detail, and so too in general

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: ולזה אומר אני יהו״ה לא שניתי, בין מלכות דאין סוף למלכות דעשיה,
phrases.en: and this is what it says, I am G-d, I have not changed, that to G-d there's no difference between *Malchus* of *Ein Sof* and *Malchus* of *Asiya*

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: כלל
וזה שכתוב מלכותך הוא מלכות כל עולמים
phrases.en: and this is what we say, that G-d's *Malchus*, that is the *Malchus* of all the worlds

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

phrases.he: עד מלכות דמלכות דעשיה,
מטעם כל הנזכר לעיל ודי למבין:
phrases.en: for this reason that we've explained, that G-d's *Malchus*, which is like His self-expression or His dominion in the simplest sense, is like even on the highest level

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: The highest level of G-d's essence is found and expressed within the lowest final thing of every single world, in detail, and so too in general.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: G-d expressed Himself as infinite, able to do anything; that is the *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*. To Him it is the same as looking outside: a tree, a little acorn, a little amoeba, any small thing He created. The same infinity and wondrousness is there, even in the smallest detail.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: On the one hand, the same infinity is found in the smallest detail. On the other hand, even the biggest thing fails to capture G-d's essence, and certainly the smallest. Both are true from the highest level to the lowest. What makes it an expression of His essence is that G-d chose to have it this way. We have to learn to recognize that; then we can appreciate what we see.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That is what it says: *malchusecha malchus kol olamim*, Your kingship is the kingship of all the worlds, down to the *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya*. On the highest level G-d is free to do whatever He wants; in *Asiya* it seems limited, within the laws of nature. Yet He chose to lower Himself and play this game, and you still see the same infinity and awesomeness there.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.title: The fractal
blocks.text: Take a fractal: it looks the same in the big picture, and if you zoom in you can zoom in infinitely and it still shows the same infinite complexity. The patterns do not repeat exactly; they are infinitely varied, always similar in a way and always different. That is mind-blowing.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That is also true of the *seder hishtalshelus*. Go to the highest level or the lowest, and you find the whole infinity of G-d's essence, even in the smallest thing. From another perspective, even the biggest totality of everything is still like a tiny nothing.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

blocks.text: That is the end of chapter 8. As we learn the details, keep this in mind: at every stage, see how it does not change anything, how it is still connected to G-d and still an expression of His essence, and then put enough together to see all the levels as one unit.

audio.lecture: Walters 2020 Edited/Shaar HaYichud/Ch 08/Shaar HaYichud 055 ch 8 part 2.mp3

What is the general *yichud*, and how does it differ from the particular?
What do "I, I am He" and "I have not changed" say about the *Malchus* of *Asiya* and the *Malchus* of the *Ein Sof*?
